_why: A transcription rather than a read. The reference checkout is read-only specification material and internal/guardrails forbids any build input — a test included — from reading a path under it, so the anti-drift check compares the declared nodes against this committed record of what the reference said. Facts about the interchange format: node names, credential type names, option names, defaults and base URLs. No n8n code.
_optionsNote: Both nodes carry these in a collection named `options`. Every member is optional: n8n stores only what the user adds, so an option never added is absent rather than defaulted. `timeout` is in milliseconds and differs per node — see `timeoutDefault` above.

options.name: reasoningEffort
options.sentAs: reasoning_effort, only when low, medium or high

_reasoningEffortNote: Adopted 2026-10-08 (BUG-ecbq28). n8n declares it on lmChatOpenAi only, shown only for a model name matching `shownWhenModelMatches`. This server offers it on both provider nodes, unconditionally, and adds `none` to n8n's three values, because a local or routed thinking model is where the effort matters most and the model name cannot be checked against a gateway's catalogue. Absent stays absent: it is sent only when the user adds it.

_unadopted.responseFormat: n8n sends `response_format: {type}` as a model kwarg. This server has no JSON-mode plumbing through ai.ModelRequest yet, and declaring an option that is collected and never sent would be worse than not offering it.
_unadopted.baseURL: an option on n8n's OpenAI node for versions below 1.1 only, hidden at 1.1 and above. This server carries the address as a top-level `baseUrl` parameter instead, because the model list loader reads parameters and cannot see a collection member or a credential field.
_unadopted.responsesApiEnabled: n8n 1.3+ switches to OpenAI's Responses API. That is a different wire protocol, not an option on this one.
